state.task: Run the unit tests in Blog Website

plan.description: Identify test framework and configuration: Examine the project structure and configuration files (such as package.json, pytest.ini, or Makefile) to determine the test runner and test command.

state.architecture:
Title: Unit Test Execution Architecture for Blog Website
Summary: Architectural design for inspecting project dependencies, configuring test runners, managing test environment variables, and executing unit tests for the Blog Website repository.
Components:
- [NEW] Test Execution Pipeline: Orchestrates test runner execution, environment variable loading, and dependency validation. (Responsibilities: Detect and invoke the appropriate test runner., Ensure execution environment variables are properly initialized., Capture and evaluate exit codes and test results.)
- [MODIFY] Environment & Dependency Loader: Manages package resolution and environment context required for test execution. (Responsibilities: Validate installation of test runner and mock dependencies., Inject required test environment variables prior to test invocation.)
Data Flow: 1. Environment & Dependency Loader checks local dependencies and loads test environment variables. -> 2. Test Execution Pipeline identifies defined test scripts and invokes the target test framework. -> 3. Test runner executes unit test suite against application modules. -> 4. Output stream and exit status are captured and evaluated against success criteria.
Dependencies: Project package manager (e.g., npm, yarn, pnpm, or pip), Test runner framework (e.g., Jest, Vitest, PyTest, or Mocha)
Risks: Missing test configuration files or unconfigured test execution scripts in repository settings.; Missing or mismatched dependencies causing module import failures during test runs.; Unhandled or missing environment variables leading to test suite execution failures.
Verification Plan: Verify that dependency installation completes cleanly without missing packages.; Execute the unit test suite command and ensure process exits with code 0.; Confirm that all unit test cases report passing status without errors or unhandled rejections.
